items.statement: Revenue growth expected in line with blended three-year historical growth for FY27.
items.quote: So, the growth should be in line with the historical numbers. So, blended three-year growth is, I think, a good number to look at for FY27.

items.statement: Margins expected broadly similar to last year; recovery visible in H2 FY27.
items.quote: No, in '27 also, you can see the recovery of the margin in next half year.

items.statement: Four projects commissioning Q4 FY27 to Q3 FY28 with aggregate peak revenue potential of INR500 crores.
items.quote: So, in total, the 4 projects commissioning between Q4 FY27 to Q3 FY28 has an aggregate peak revenue potential of about INR500 crores at full utilization against a FY26 revenue base of INR445 crores.

items.statement: Brownfield OEM contact sensor plant of 50,000 sq ft to be commissioned by Q3 FY28, peak revenue INR120 crores.
items.quote: We are also building a brownfield plant of about 50,000 square feet within Unit 1 for OEM contact sensors, which is expected to be commissioned by Q3 FY28, which will have a peak revenue potential of about INR120 crores

items.statement: New 50,000 sq ft plant within Unit 6 for medium-voltage heaters to be completed by Q1 FY28, peak revenue INR200 crores.
items.quote: The new products will be supported by a new 50,000 square foot plant within Unit 6 that is expected to be completed by Q1 FY28, which will carry a peak revenue potential of about INR200 crores.

items.statement: Greenfield Unit 8 for specialized cables to be completed by Q2 FY28, peak revenue INR60 crores.
items.quote: So, for cables, we have also started construction for Unit 8. It is a greenfield project and should be completed by Q2 FY28 with a peak revenue potential of INR60 crores.

items.statement: Victura JV facility production to commence by Q4 FY27, peak revenue potential INR120 crores.
items.quote: For the joint venture with Victura Technologies, we have signed an agreement to acquire an 80,000 square foot facility that already has a shed built on top of it. So, production should commence by Q4 FY27 with a peak revenue potential of about INR120 crores.

items.statement: OEM and new products expected to contribute more than 25% of revenue starting FY28.
items.quote: So, all in all, we expect, I mean, especially the OEM part plus the new product part, to start contributing significantly, I mean, more than 25% of our revenue starting FY28.

items.statement: New age industry products expected to grow at high 20s or 30s over next 2-3 years.
items.quote: the growth, I would say, for the new age industry or the new kind of products would be much faster, and we expect this to be in a double-digit number or maybe in the high 20s or 30s in the next few years, next maybe 2 years-3 years.

items.statement: EDGE series pyrometers co-developed with Micro-Epsilon to start dispatches in Q3 FY27.
items.quote: We are also launching a new series of next-generation pyrometers, the EDGE series, which is co-developed by our partner, Micro-Epsilon, which should start dispatches Q3 this year.

items.statement: Medium-voltage heaters targeting explosion-proof certification by Q4 FY27.
items.quote: So, these heaters have already been tested up to 7.2 kilowatts and we're targeting explosion-proof certification by Q4 FY27.

items.statement: Typical heavy industry order book is 4-4.5 months; OEM visibility is 9-12 months.
items.quote: So, our typical customer base, which is based on heavy industries, so the order book is like 4, 4.5 months. That is a typical order book for us. But these kind of OEM players, so they have a much larger visibility. So, there the order cycle, like visibility could be maybe for 9 to 12 months' visibility is there.

items.statement: Raw materials booked at order receipt; price fluctuations passed through to customers.
items.quote: And regarding the inventory price fluctuation, actually we book the raw materials at the time of receiving the orders. So, we pass through the fluctuations to the customer.

items.statement: No negative revenue impact expected next quarters from geopolitical situation; mid-term positive.
items.quote: For the next quarters, I would I don't think there is any negative impact. For maybe next years, it could be a positive impact.

items.statement: Expects volume growth trend to continue in Q2 FY27.
items.quote: Going forward, in the Q2 also, we are expecting a decent, the trend of increase in the volumes is reflecting in the quarter two as well.

items.statement: Confident of sustaining 25-30% volume growth going forward.
items.quote: Yes. We feel that the way we see the trends currently, we feel that we are very confident of sustaining some of the volume growth and the endeavor is actually to improve that.

items.statement: Generic annual capex for the group is INR35-40 crores.
items.quote: So the generic capex plan every year for the group is around INR35 crores to INR40 crores per annum.

items.statement: Board approved INR30 crores for expansion into five new Asian geographies; 10-15% is capex.
items.quote: Out of the INR30 crores that we are going to invest over a period of time, generally the capex in our industry is very low. Around 10% to 15% out of this INR30 crores will be the capex, which will be the initial setting up cost of the offices and smaller warehouses that may be required.

items.statement: INR20 crores approved for existing overseas subsidiaries in UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Vietnam.
items.quote: This is basically for our subsidiaries in the in the UAE, in Saudi Arabia, these are the primarily and Vietnam.

items.statement: Targets ROE around 15% going forward.
items.quote: But as we grow along towards the year closure and the years ahead, the targeted range will always be around 15% that we would ideally want to remain on.

items.statement: Fuel cost is a full pass-through to customers; yields move with fuel index.
items.quote: The fuel cost is always a pass-through for us. Whatever the fuel index, which is globally available, the indexes are very easily available and tangible across the world. So those are absolutely passed through to the customers, whether they are in air or in ocean, even in trucking.

items.statement: Pharma share grew from 8-9% to 23% of business; pharma gross margins higher than overall.
items.quote: Before Odyssey had come into our portfolio, we were about 8% to 9% of our business was pharmaceutical, and which grew to 23% last year.

items.statement: Air cargo business is approximately 81% of revenue, up from 77% in FY26.
items.quote: Yes, so as you would have seen in the quarter 1 performance, the air cargo business is approximately 81%, which has increased from 77% in overall FY26 number.

items.statement: Pharma, textiles, automotive, and consumer electronics are growing sectors.
items.quote: The business trends that we have been seeing, pharmaceutical continues to remain a good sector for us. The other sectors that have been also significantly growing for us are the textiles and readymade garments plus automotive and also consumer electronics.

items.statement: EOW matter sub judice; management sees no financial impact.
items.quote: So, the matter is still sub judice and under investigation in its final stages. And currently, as we see it, we don't see any possible impact on us financially on this case.

items.statement: ASAP tech platform to launch in 30-60 days.
items.quote: So we are very hopeful that in the next 30 to 60 days, we should be able to launch the platform.

items.statement: Repaid ~INR140 crores of borrowings; benefit in Q3/Q4 interest cost.
items.quote: So as of date, we have already kind of repaid around INR140 crores of approximate borrowings to the financial institution and the banks, which will obviously have an effect in the Q3 and the Q4 numbers on the interest cost.

items.statement: New international markets break-even: EBITDA 15-18 months, PAT 2-3 years.
items.quote: The break-even point, as Mr. Yash mentioned, on the profitability at the PAT level is a cycle of 2 to 3 years. But on the on the EBITDA break-even side, it generally happens in a in a scenario of 15 to 18 months is what we look at.

items.statement: Target to return to similar financial position by FY29; FY28 expected to be a year of challenges and discovery.
items.quote: Our endeavor would be to try and get to the similar situation as we had by FY29. FY28 will be a year of challenges and discovery, maybe.

items.statement: General insurance revenue may compress to 33-40% of current levels under draft regulations; life insurance NPV similar to today.
items.quote: From the current regulations, in terms of net present value, we think the life insurance net present value is similar to what we have today, and should not have a major impact. But in terms of general insurance, it is between one-third to 40% of what we have today.

items.statement: Expect 15-20% volume recovery from price elasticity of 1 if commission savings passed to customers as lower premiums.
items.quote: At least what was shown to us was that there's a price elasticity of at least 1. Which means for every 1% reduction in price, there should be at least 1% growth. So, my view is at least 15-20% we should get back in terms of growth.

items.statement: Hiring to slow down; H1 FY27 hired ~6,000 people but would have hired only ~2,000 if regulations known earlier.
items.quote: This year, in H1, we hired about 6,000 people, and we hired them because we wanted to make this growth. But maybe if this had come out earlier, we may not have hired 6,000 people, we may have hired 2,000.

items.statement: Will not acquire small brokers/agents due to DNA mismatch; focus on building own employee base.
items.quote: We are not in a mode of acquiring any of the small brokers or agents, because, fundamentally, the DNA doesn't match.

items.statement: Revenue to grow at least 20% year-on-year, PAT to grow 25-30%.
items.quote: As I told you, we'll be growing at about 20% minimum year-on-year. And bottom line will grow at minimum at 25% to 30%.

items.statement: EBITDA margin to be maintained at 24-25%.
items.quote: EBITDA margin will be maintained at about 24% to 25%.

items.statement: INR30 crores capex allotted for this year, to be implemented within one year.
items.quote: We have got INR30 crores of object now. We will be implementing that.

items.statement: Capex of INR30 crores will add INR100 crores to business.
items.quote: with current capex of INR30 crores, which you're taking it from IPO, this will take us -- this will add another INR100 crores to our business.

items.statement: Planning INR350-500 crores capex for new 6.5-acre land over 2-3 years.
items.quote: I am preparing that for INR350 crores to INR500 crores.

items.statement: Price revision effective April 1, compensation to be received in Q2.
items.quote: that price revision we got it effective 1st of April, but we will be getting it in the second quarter.

items.statement: Domestic business expected to grow 15-20%.
items.quote: even domestic business also I'm expecting a growth of about 15% to 20%.

items.statement: Plan to achieve 50% export and 50% domestic in five years.
items.quote: in five years, we have decided to go for 50% export and 50% domestic.

items.statement: Revenue to reach INR500 crores in five years.
items.quote: Five years down the line, we'll go to 500.

items.statement: EBITDA margin to increase 0.5-1% annually to reach 25%.
items.quote: we are planning to increase our EBITDA margin year -on-year by about 0.5%, 1%, so that we'll touch 25%.

items.statement: No single customer exceeds 15% of business to mitigate risk.
items.quote: We don't have a single customer who is having more than 15% business with us.

items.statement: Entering data center opportunity within one year.
items.quote: we'll be entering into this data center opportunity over a period of next one year's time positively.

items.statement: R&D spending around 1% of revenue.
items.quote: R&D, we are spending around 1% of our revenue.

items.statement: Setting up 100% subsidiary in USA for warehouse and business.
items.quote: an entity of Hy-Tech, 100% subsidiary, will be set up there, and it will be -- that business will start.

items.statement: Targeting 20-25% revenue and EBITDA growth for FY27, with +/-5% variance.
items.quote: Based on our current visibility and business outlook, we are definitely targeting 20% and 25% growth for this current fiscal year in our revenues and our EBITDA, respectively.

items.statement: Plans to invest INR200-250 crores annually for next 2-3 years.
items.quote: But the visibility that I can currently give you based on our operating cash flows is minimum INR200 crores to INR250 crores each year for the next two to three years.

items.statement: Signed 5-year take-or-pay contract for insulin drug substance.
items.quote: we have signed a 5 year take-or-pay contract for insulin as a drug substance in the biopharma space

items.statement: Signed 10-year take-or-pay contract with US company for alternative protein.
items.quote: a 10-year take-or-pay contract with a US-based company for an alternative protein product

items.statement: Term sheet signed with European company for alternative protein product.
items.quote: it is a term sheet which we have signed with a European company for an alternate protein product, again.

items.statement: Term sheet signed with large US pharma for dual-chamber vial products; definitive agreement expected early Q3 FY27.
items.quote: in August 2026, we signed a term sheet with a very large US-based pharmaceutical multinational covering products from this platform. And this definitive agreement is at the very advanced stage, and we expect it to be signed in early Q3 FY27.

items.statement: API gross margin to continue around 60% and EBITDA margin close to 30%.
items.quote: And we'll continue to do gross margins around 60%. Of course, we are currently much higher than 60%, but I think that's the base that that we expect our business to continue with. And similarly on the EBITDA lines, we are we are very close to 30% margins, and this is what we'd like to maintain.

items.statement: New businesses expected to have >70% gross margin and >35% EBITDA margin at maturity.
items.quote: Usually, this industry trend is higher than 70% as gross margins and higher than 35% as EBITDA margins.

items.statement: API business expected to grow high single digits.
items.quote: So, our API segment is currently, as I said, we are looking at the growth in high single digits, right?

items.statement: API share of revenue to drop below half in 5-6 years as new businesses grow.
items.quote: But I think going forward, let's say, 5, 6 years of vision if you're to talk about, this should be definitely less than half.

items.statement: First couple of quarters lumpy due to new business expenses without revenue; strong H2 expected.
items.quote: While we expect the first couple of quarters to remain lumpy due to the drag of new business expenses without corresponding revenue in the same period, we expect a very strong second half on the back of milestone cash flows coming in and some small revenues from biotech CDMO services in quarter four.

items.statement: New business revenues expected to start in next 6-12 months.
items.quote: And this will, of course, serve our future growth engines, and we should start seeing first of these revenues new revenues in the next 6 to 12 months.

items.statement: R&D spending to continue at 3-4% of sales, potentially increasing to 5%.
items.quote: So, we consistently have been investing about 3% to 4% of our sales as R&D, and we expect this to continue, probably with a slight increase as well to about 5% in the future.

items.statement: Operating expenses from new businesses to continue at INR23 crores per quarter for next 2-3 quarters.
items.quote: On the expenses drag of expenses from this new businesses, this INR23 crores as a run rate should more or less continue for the next two, three quarters in terms of the run rate of expenses

items.statement: Sharon AI GPU revenue to start from Q3 FY27, targeting early to mid Q3.
items.quote: So, from Q3 onwards, we will see the revenue coming in from the AI factory in Sydney.

items.statement: Own GPU capacity to reach 1,500 GPUs by mid/end Q4 FY27.
items.quote: The target is to touch around 1,500 GPUs. We'll be deploying those by January or February next year, which will be mid of Q4. Mid of Q4 or end of Q4.

items.statement: Targeting INR 1,500 crores capex in FY27, funded by customer advance, IPO proceeds, and partial debt.
items.quote: FY27, we are targeting to conclude around INR1,500 crores of capex, and additional INR1,500 crores, whatever has happened, I exactly don't have the numbers in front of me right now, but we will be doing additional INR1,500 crores of capex in FY27.

items.statement: Domestic order book of INR 3,000 crores with 3-year duration.
items.quote: Domestic business, we have got around INR3,000 crores of an order book with us. International is much larger than that.

items.statement: International pipeline of over 50,000 GPUs.
items.quote: We have a strong funnel of more than 50,000 GPUs right now, and we are trying to figure out how we will deliver that, from where, all locations, which all locations we can deliver the pipeline.

items.statement: Targeting PAT margins of 15-20% on GPU deals.
items.quote: We are targeting PAT margins in the range of 15% to 20%. So, that's our target PAT margin. We will not work for anything lesser than that.

items.statement: GPU rental rates expected to increase; industry billing $5-6 per GPU per hour.
items.quote: So, the industry standard where people are currently billing upwards of $5 per GPU per hour that is what everyone in the industry, $5, $6 per hour. So, we are also going to bill our customer in that range only.

items.statement: Domestic business seeing 30-40% CAGR.
items.quote: Domestic, currently, we are seeing a CAGR of 30% to 40%.

items.statement: Revenue mix: IaaS 51%, Managed Services 31.31%, SaaS 17.55% in Q1 FY27.
items.quote: For Q1 FY27, our IaaS revenue was 51% of the total revenue, Managed Service revenue was 31.31%, and SaaS revenue was 17.55%. And this will go steady in future years as well.

items.statement: GPU supply constraint with delivery delays of 4-9 months.
items.quote: It is already a constraint. There is a delivery timeline delay of 4 months, 6 months, 9 months also. So, we are leveraging our relationships to get the deliveries expedited.

items.statement: Employee strength to remain around 1,000 despite adding ~100 for the deal.
items.quote: Yes. There will be an addition of close to 100 more people because of this deal. But we will also have some churn, voluntary and involuntary churn also. So, we don't expect the people count to go beyond 1,000.

items.statement: No forward-looking revenue or profitability guidance for FY27/FY28.
items.quote: No. We cannot give any forward-looking numbers, so that is not yet, like, company has not planned to disclose anything like that.
